bindings.label: The golden pyramid: drag across it for Drive; a sunburst grows out behind it, an eye opens on its face, and small flames rise on its slopes
The left stalk: drag up and down for the Upper 16' drawbar; it grows a new branch for every step, sap rising as it does
The right stalk: drag up and down for the Upper 5 1/3' drawbar; it grows a new branch for every step, sap rising as it does
The sleepy green creature is the rotor: tap its ear to cycle Stop, Slow, Fast; a whirlwind spins up round it, it wakes, and at Fast it raises its little arm
The worm swells with Expression: drag up and down; ripples spread, bands climb it, its crest blooms and its head flares into a trumpet
The stream: tap to switch upper vibrato; its froth bubbles up into a cloud of bubbles, a rainbow arcs into the pool and it rains
The cloud: drag across it to age the wheels; mushrooms and little flowers sprout along its top
The sleepy eye: tap to switch percussion; it wakes and springs out on a coil
The mushroom stem, top centre: drag for the Upper 8' drawbar; its curled hand unrolls into a long arm that lifts its blue drop higher each step, then a second arm rises and waves

The pink column between the stalks: drag up and down for the Upper 4' drawbar; a pink caterpillar climbs into the gap one fat segment a step, then lifts its head, opens its sleepy eyes and curls out its antennae

The horned mask: drag for the Upper 2 2/3' drawbar; it turns into a snail, step by step: its horn tips swell into sleepy eyes, a candy spiral shell winds out of its back one turn at a time, its eyes open and it sings

The eye tree: drag for the Upper 2' drawbar; it turns into a songbird, one step at a time: crest feathers fan up, its beak comes out and opens singing, a lumpy wing lifts and feathers, and its eye wakes last
The lavender straw creature: drag for the Upper 1 3/5' drawbar; it becomes a flower: two leaves unfurl from its tail, then a big candy petal opens behind its head with every step
The tall white cloud at the right edge: drag for the Upper 1 1/3' drawbar; it turns into a cockatoo, wing feathers, then a sleepy head and beak, then its crest fans up, its eye wakes and it squawks

The party-hat cone: drag for the Upper 1' drawbar; it is the big eye's beak: it splits and opens wide like a baby bird's a little more each step, shows its pink mouth and tongue, then sings the highest note in big candy crescents, one more each step
The pink trunk with antlers: drag for the Lower 16' drawbar; it turns into a giraffe, its neck rising over the horizon step by step until a sleepy head looks out and opens its eye

The coral antler hand: drag for the Lower 5 1/3' drawbar; it grows like coral, a chunky branch with a big candy polyp out of its antler, prongs, thumb and side at every step, then an eye opens in its palm and the loop below opens into a mouth round its pink tongue
The pink creature waving: drag for the Lower 8' drawbar; it twists up into a pink balloon animal, one balloon per step from the bottom, and its balloon head opens an eye
The pink figure: drag for the Lower 4' drawbar; it opens an eye, its neck rises out of its ring mouth step by step and the same head pops out on top, an octave up, poking its tongue out further
The blue-purple fish: drag for the Lower 2 2/3' drawbar; it wakes and opens its mouth, its tail unfurls into a flowing betta veil a lobe at a time, and its fins flare into veils last
The blue ghost with orange horns, top centre: the Lower 2' drawbar; drag up and its twins pop up beside it and it waves
The cloud hill under the rocket: drag for the Lower 1 3/5' drawbar; it billows into exhaust puff by puff, then the rocket's flames ignite and roar
The mitten hand: drag for the Lower 1 1/3' drawbar; the narwhal's arm stretches up a segment per step and its mitten pops up waving high above the crowd

The pink collar of the horned creature, top left: drag for the Lower 1' drawbar; its mint flipper lifts out of the cape as an arm, a segment a step, a big hand opens at the top and swishes as it waves
The sandy ground: the Pedal 16' drawbar
The magenta cushion: the Pedal 8' drawbar
The orange sprite: drag for Pedal Sustain; it morphs into a starfish, then a butterfly, then a jellyfish
The big eyeball: tap for percussion Second or Third; on Third a peacock fan opens behind it and its eye turns into a disco ball
The pink cap: tap for percussion decay Slow or Fast; at Fast it turns into a hare: its sleepy eye opens wide, two long ears spring up and its nose pops out
The saucer: tap for percussion volume Normal or Soft; on Soft it fluffs up into a woolly sheep, puff by puff, its head pops out wide awake, then its eyes droop shut and it nods off
The tunnel: tap through the six vibrato and chorus modes; rainbow rings rise out of its depth and two eyes open in the dark
The river bank: tap for lower-manual vibrato; two frogs pop up on it, wake and sing, their throat sacs ballooning
The tunnel rim lights while the rotating speaker is on: tap

The pink cloud: drag across for the horn/drum balance; toward the horn it turns into a pink elephant: its ear and head billow up, its sleepy eye wakes, its trunk rises and it trumpets through a golden bell
The snout creature: drag for the Leslie mic distance; its eye opens and a telescope slides out of it
The long coral tongue: drag for the Leslie mic angle; its tip splits and splits again, fanning out
The lying creature: drag across for Key Click; it turns into a party narwhal, candy tusk, spouting fountain and all
The fan hand: drag for Release Click; its fingers pop into popcorn one after another and two kernels fly off
The splash bush scribbles with tonewheel Leakage: drag across
The purple path: drag for Crosstalk; it rears up into a two-headed snake: two necks rise out of it, sleepy eyes wake, and the heads chatter at each other, one mouth opening just after the other
The acorn frog: tap for complex or pure tonewheels; complex turns its acorns into two graffiti eyeballs
The striped shell: tap for gear or equal tuning
The left cliff turns in colour as the master tuning rises above 440 Hz (display only)
The sky brightens as the output Volume rises above -8 dB (display only)
The bunny slab shows the manual mode (display only: it changes which keys play which manual)
The purple ledge turns in colour as the split point rises above C4 (display only)
The grey ground shows the pedal split (display only)
